# PDF fixtures

`encrypted.pdf` is a one-page synthetic AES-256 protected fixture generated with pypdf 6.10.0 for the encrypted-input rejection test. The test does not use its fixture password and does not attempt to decrypt it.

`demo-first.pdf` and `demo-second-rotated.pdf` are synthetic, text-only PDFs used for browser walkthroughs and screenshots. They contain no personal or customer data. `invalid.pdf` is plain text with a PDF extension to exercise the malformed-file path.
